name: Gael
source:
Current Master of the Grand Houses, Gael’s sweet and noble persona won the hearts of the citizens of Limbo and has ensured his position for the past five elections. However, the beloved Master has a secret that could end his reputation and plunge his already torn city into chaos.

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
